data.name: Alin
data.long_meaning: The name Alin originated from the Romanian language and is derived from the Latin word 'albus' meaning 'white'. The name Alin can be interpreted as 'Little Dark One' due to its contrasting meaning. In Romanian mythology, Alin is a name given to the god of the forest, mountains, and fertility.
